nature: DERIVED path-resolution and re-binding index. Not a replacement for the historical manifest, which is preserved unmodified.

hash_semantics.git_blob_oid: Git object id of the blob at the integration commit.
hash_semantics.raw_blob_sha256: SHA-256 over raw blob bytes from `git cat-file blob`.
hash_semantics.worktree_sha256: SHA-256 of the Windows working-tree file. Segregated on purpose: core.autocrlf=true converts LF to CRLF on checkout, so this value differs from raw_blob_sha256 for text artifacts by design.
hash_semantics.rule: Raw-blob equality is the identity criterion. Working-tree difference confined to CRLF is reported as CRLF_CHECKOUT_ONLY and is never counted as content drift.

rename_map.rule: ':' -> '_' in receipt basenames; content identical before/after.

thesis_version_changes.interpretation: The historical manifest binds the pre-merge thesis version. The integration merge appended the 2026-10-27 A-stage and C-boundary addenda, so the expected hash no longer describes the current blob. Both versions are retained; the old manifest is not rewritten.
